An '''abandoned Separatist base''' was located on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in a [[LFA-509 system/Legends|deserted system]] that was once controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].

==History==
This base was later occupied by the [[Believers]], and near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Cularin Militia|Cularin Armed Forces]] dispatched a task force on a [[Destruction|mission]] to it, to try and recover some intelligence. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] and some [[Clone Marines]] were sent down to get the base's power back online and recover any available data. However, some [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] powered up and attacked them. The power was eventually turned back on, but when this happened, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] spoke over a speaker and began a countdown for the base's destruction. The heroes stopped this, but were trapped in a room, and Sidious told them over a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that he had lured them there to keep them safe, while he began an [[Destruction of the Almas Academy|attack]] elsewhere. The door opened three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, and the heroes escaped the base.
